HSP visa points calculator

Estimate your Highly Skilled Professional points toward the 70-point bar.

Take-home pay estimate

A rough estimate for a single company employee in Tokyo (2024 rates). Not tax advice. Real deductions depend on dependents, city and company.

HSP visa points estimate

Advanced Specialized / Technical Activities (type ii). 70 points qualifies; 80 shortens the path to permanent residency. Indicative only. The Immigration Bureau makes the final call.

Meet the team

The people behind Tokyo Samurai Dev.

Tokyo Samurai Dev is built by LongWave, a licensed recruiting agency in Tokyo. We are a small bilingual team who talk to engineers every day, and we want your move to Japan to be a good one.

Product owner, Tokyo Samurai Dev · Global Talent Acquisition Lead, LongWave
